purpose: Test whether the provider boundary is explained by MiMo's lack of model-initiated recommendation inspection.
taskSource: Reuse the exact 32 matched task hashes and recommender allocation from the temperature experiments.
recommenderAllocation: Reuse the exact frozen task-to-recommender-and-seed assignment.

intervention.controllerAction: Before the first LLM call, view the highest-ranked platform item available in the frozen candidate set.
intervention.traceConsequence: The controller-required view is retained in the realized trace and exclusion mask.
intervention.primaryOutcomeExclusion: Whole-trace divergence is not primary because the controller action can mechanically differ across exposure arms.

shamSemantics: Both held sham arms receive the same deterministic required platform inspection and then independent LLM calls.

generation.privacy: Send pseudonymous candidate IDs and derived constraint, utility, rank, and novelty features only.

primaryEstimands.resolvedActionDivergence: the final selected item or abandon outcome differs between immediate and held arms
primaryEstimands.persistentResolvedActionFeedback: resolved action diverges and next-task Top-10 displacement is greater than zero
primaryEstimands.adjustedPersistentResolvedActionFeedback: persistent resolved-action feedback in immediate-versus-held minus held-sham-a-versus-held-sham-b

decisionRules.interactionDepthMediates: MiMo adjusted persistent resolved-action feedback is positive, its sham persistent resolved-action rate is at most 0.05, and reliability gates pass.
decisionRules.interactionDepthInsufficient: MiMo adjusted persistent resolved-action feedback is zero or negative while reliability and sham gates pass.
decisionRules.stochasticityDominated: Either provider's sham persistent resolved-action rate exceeds 0.05.
decisionRules.noGo: valid action rate falls below 0.95, timeout rate reaches 0.05, or privacy validation fails.

claimBoundary: A positive result would identify required recommendation inspection as a causal contributor within this controller-model system, not as a general property of either provider or production shopping agents.
